rapport_notes: Friendly and efficient on a small, quick move; clarified the TV-mount vs. media-console detail without making it feel like an interrogation.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors... or any particular concern about parking access?" - asked after bedroom, item list, boxes, and floor were already covered.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A - no concern was raised in response.

top_strength: Caught and clarified an important detail (TV vs. media console, not mounted) that could have caused confusion on move day.
coaching_note: This move sits right at the 2.5-hour minimum, so none of the Save Your Ass lines about beating the estimate or self-prep discounts were used - worth building a short version of that pitch for minimum-hour jobs too.
